title: Family and Medical Leave Act of 1993
verified_how: Fetched govinfo USCODE-2024 29 U.S.C. 2601. The Short Title note says the Act 'may be cited as the Family and Medical Leave Act of 1993'. Current through 6 January 2025.
notes: Gives unpaid, job-protected leave only. No federal statute requires paid vacation, paid holidays or general paid sick leave; those come from state and local law or from contract.
